blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics: the embedding and the unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods either reuse a fixed lens or treat the states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state the way the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that read it next and adaptive to the context. Lexical reference frames approximate it by reading a state through the model's own remaining layers with a stated number of rounds of attention between positions and a typical attention output for the rest, without fitting to the model's output. No lens, with fixed directions per layer, can exceed the square root of the native frame's coherence, 0.30 and 0.35 at mid-depth of SmolLM3-3B and OLMo3-7B, whereas the first-order frame, LexFrame[1], reaches 0.97 and 0.97 and reads a state within 0.16 nats of the model's output. Its coefficients attribute predictions more faithfully than attribution patching, its lexical basis steers a prediction while sparing other tokens, and its confident readings would let an early exit skip 0.45 and 0.42 of the layers, where lenses skip almost none. In this way, lexical reference frames make every hidden state of the model readable, attributable and steerable.
blocks.zh: 一个语言模型的词汇是它的本土语义:嵌入和未嵌入固定了剩余流两端状态的含义. 在它们之间,现有的方法要么重新使用固定镜头,要么把状态当作点云来对待,而且既不是读取模型的状态. 我们主张,每个隐藏状态都有一个本土的参考框架,由下面读取的地层所诱导,并适应上下文. 语法参考框架通过模型自身所剩的地层读取一个状态来取近似,在位置和其余的典型的注意输出之间有说明的几轮注意,而不适应模型的输出. 每层有固定取向的镜头,均不能超过原生帧相通的平方根,在SmolLM3-3B和OLMo3-7B的中深处为0.30和0.35;而一阶帧LexFrame[1]则能达到0.97和0.97并读取模型输出0.16纳特内的一个状态. 其系数属性预测比归属补丁更忠实,其词典基础在引导预测的同时省取了其他符号,而其自信的读取会让一个早期的退出跳过0.45和0.42的地层,其中镜头跳过几乎无. 这样,词汇参考框架使模型的每一个隐蔽状态都可以读取,可归属和可引导.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Between its input and output tokens, a language model computes nothing but states of its residual stream, which every layer reads and writes ( Elhage et al., 2021 ) .
Its vocabulary is in this sense the native semantics of the model, the only units of meaning that it is designed to receive and to express.
The model defines the lexical meaning of a state at the two ends of the stream: the embedding assigns each token a state, and the unembedding maps a final state to logits over tokens.
Intermediate states lack such a definition, although interpretability research and its applications read them constantly: early exit and self-speculative decoding stop the computation at a layer whose reading already names the output ( Schuster et al., 2022 ; Elhoushi et al., 2024 ) , hallucination detectors judge an answer by its hidden states ( Orgad et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and knowledge editors locate and rewrite facts at intermediate layers ( Meng et al., 2023 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) .
Each depends on how faithfully a tool such as a lens reads these states, and model compression, which distils a smaller or pruned student by matching the intermediate states of its teacher, relies on what these states mean ( Romero et al., 2015 ; Dasgupta and Cohn, 2025 ; Muralidharan et al., 2024 ) .
This meaning is set by the remaining layers, which read each state in the context of its prefix.
blocks.zh:
在其输入符和输出符之间,一个语言模型只计算其残余流的状态,每层都读写(Elhage等人,2021年).
它的词汇在这个意义上是模型的本土语义,是它设计来接收和表达的唯一意义单位.
该模型定义了一个状态在流两端的词典意义:嵌入式指定了每个符号一个状态,未嵌入式绘制了一个最终状态以登录到符号上.
中级国家缺乏这种定义,尽管可解释性研究及其应用不断读取:早期退出和自我投机解码停止计算,其读取已命名产出的层(Shuster等人,2022年;Elhoushi等人,2024年),幻觉探测器判断其隐藏状态的答案(Orgad等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年),以及知识编辑在中间层查找和改写事实(Meng等人,2023年;Fang等人,2025年)。
每一个都取决于一个工具如镜头如何忠实地读取这些状态,模型压缩通过匹配其老师的中间状态来提炼一个较小或被挤压的学生,这取决于这些状态的含义(Romero等人,2015年;Dasgupta和Cohn,2025年;Muralidharan等人,2024年)。
此含义由剩余层设置,这些层在其前缀的上下文中读取每个状态.

blocks.en:
Two families of methods address these states and fail in opposite ways.
The first reads a state with a lens: the logit lens applies the output frame to every layer unchanged ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ) , the tuned lens learns one affine map per layer fitted to the model’s output ( Belrose et al., 2023 ) , and the Jacobian lens averages the Jacobian of the remaining layers over positions and prompts ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
Each fixes one linear map per layer, so every state of a layer is read identically, regardless of its prefix.
The second family keeps every state and does without a reading.
It treats the states of a layer as a point cloud and reports its rank, intrinsic dimension, anisotropy or similarity to other layers ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ; Ansuini et al., 2019 ; Garrido et al., 2022 ; Skean et al., 2025 ) .
Such statistics describe how the states are distributed rather than how the model uses them: two states close in the cloud may lead to different predictions, and two distant ones to the same.
blocks.zh:
方法的两组处理这些状态,但以相反的方式失败。
第一种读取带有透镜的状态:logit透镜将输出框应用到每层不变(怀旧代数,2020年),调制的透镜每层学习一个符合模型输出的芬美图(Belrose等人,2023年),雅各比亚透镜平均剩余层的雅各比亚人超过位置和提示(Gurnee等人,2026年).
每个图层每层修补一个线性映射,因此一个图层的每个状态都相同读取,无论它的前缀如何.
第二眷属守各邦而作是念.
它将层态作为点云处理,并报告其等级,内在维度,异构性或与其他层的相似性(Kornblith等人,2019年;Ansuini等人,2019年;Garrido等人,2022年;Skean等人,2025年).
这种统计描述了各州的分布,而不是模型如何使用它们:两个靠近云层的州可能导致不同的预测,两个遥远的州导致相同的预测.

blocks.en:
Both families omit the frame in which the model itself reads a state: the directions along which a state changes the logit of a token are a property of the remaining layers and therefore differ from layer to layer; because these layers attend to the preceding tokens, they also differ between contexts, so no method with one map per layer can follow them, however it is fitted.
In OLMo3-7B (Figure 1 ), after layer 16 of 32, the logit-lens direction for a token deviates by 75 degrees from the model’s own lexical readout and the Jacobian-lens direction by 77 degrees, and four layers before the output both still deviate by at least 40 degrees.
blocks.zh:
两个家族都省略了模型本身读取一个状态的框:一个状态改变一个代号的对数的方向是剩余层的属性,因此各层不同;因为这些代号处理之前的代号,它们也因上下文的不同而不同,所以没有一种每层一个地图的方法可以跟随它们,不管它是否配对.
在OLMo3-7B(图1)中,在32的第16层之后,一个符号的对数-连线方向偏离了该模型本身的词典读取和雅各比连线方向77度,在输出前的四层仍然偏差至少40度.

blocks.en:
Our starting point is that these directions, the lexical readouts, form a reference frame: we call their family at a state its lexical reference frame , and the frame that the complete model induces its native frame .
The native frame returns the model’s output at every layer, so a useful frame withholds a stated part of this computation: the frame of order n n , written LexFrame [ n n ] , transports a state through the model’s own layers with n n rounds of attention between positions and replaces the remaining attention by a typical attention output, estimated once per layer from unlabelled text. LexFrame [0] reads what a state holds by itself, LexFrame [1] what it draws from its prefix, and LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] is the native frame.
The idea is simple: read a state the way the model reads it, through the layers that remain and with the context it sees. A lens ignores the context and is therefore bounded; a frame uses it, as far as its order allows.
As nothing is fitted to the model’s output, lexical reference frames are comparable across layers, checkpoints and models.
blocks.zh:
我们的出发点是,这些方向, 语法读取, 形成了一个参考框架: 我们称他们的家庭在一个语法参考框架的国家,
本地帧在每个层返回模型的输出, 所以一个有用的帧会保留这个计算中一个已声明的部分: 命令 n 的帧, 写作 LexFrame [nn], 将一个状态通过模型自己的层, 在位置之间以 n 的 n 轮注意来传输, 用一个典型的注意输出来代替剩下的注意, 从无标签文本中每层估计一次. LexFrame [0] 读到一个国家自己持有什么,LexFrame [1] 它从它的前缀中提取什么,LexFrame [QQ\\fty] 是本土框架.
这个想法很简单:读取模型读取方式的状态,通过所剩的层层以及它所看到的背景. 一个镜头忽略了上下文,因此是被限定的;一个帧在其命令允许的范围内使用它.
由于没有与模型产出相适应,所以不同层次、检查站和模型的词汇参照框架是可比的。

blocks.en:
We evaluate lexical reference frames at every layer of SmolLM3-3B ( Hugging Face, 2025 ) and OLMo3-7B ( Team OLMo, 2025 ) and at 16 of their training checkpoints, against the logit lens, the Jacobian lens, a supervised probe and distances on the point cloud.
From the middle layers on, LexFrame [1] recovers the native frame’s lexical readouts beyond the bound of every lens and matches the model’s output in content and confidence, which lenses do only near the output; one round of attention to the prefix closes most of the gap that LexFrame [0] leaves.
Its readings settle on the model’s prediction early enough for an early exit to skip more than two fifths of the layers, and they stay faithful along training while the logit lens degrades.
Distances on the point cloud barely predict the effect of replacing a state, as lexical readouts lie almost entirely outside the directions in which the states vary.
In the coordinates of the frame, the lexical basis writes a prediction into the stream more selectively than the readout, and differences of coefficients attribute it to layers and sublayers more faithfully than attribution patching.
We therefore expect lexical reference frames to be a strong alternative to lenses in these applications.
In summary, this paper makes three contributions.
blocks.zh:
我们评价SmolLM3-3B(Hugging Face,2025年)和OLMo3-7B(Team OLMo,2025年)的每一层以及16个训练检查站的词汇参考框架,对照对数镜,雅各比镜,一个有监督的探测器和点云上的距离.
从中间层开始,LexFrame [1] 恢复了本地帧的词汇读取,超越了每个镜头的界限,与模型在内容和置信度上的输出相匹配,而这个镜头只在输出附近进行;一回合对前缀的关注关闭了LexFrame[0] 留下的大部分缺口.
它的读数在模型的预测上足够早,可以提早退出,跳过超过五分之二的地层,在对数镜头退化时,它们始终保持对训练的忠诚.
点云上的距离几乎无法预测替换状态的效果,因为词汇读数几乎完全在状态不同的方向之外。
在帧的坐标中,词典基础比读出更有选择地将预测写入流中,系数的差异将其归因于层和子层比归属补丁更忠实.
因此,我们期望词汇参照框架成为这些应用中的镜片的有力替代品。
总之,本文件提出了三项意见。

blocks.en: • We show that the layers that remain give every hidden state its own frame in the vocabulary, and we prove that no lens with one map per layer can follow this frame across the different contexts in which a state occurs. • We define frames that read a hidden state in the model’s native semantics through its own layers with a chosen amount of context, and we compute them in closed form from unlabelled text, without any training. • We show on two model families and their training checkpoints that these frames follow the model from the middle layers on, where lenses fail, and support early exit, steering and attribution at every layer of the model.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work on the intermediate layers of language models asks which tokens a state stands for, how the states of a layer are distributed, and which directions or components drive a prediction, and a reference frame bears on all three questions.
blocks.zh: 语言模型中间层的前期工作询问一个状态代表什么,一个层次的状态如何分布,以及哪个方向或组件驱动一个预测,一个参考框架对所有三个问题都有影响.

blocks.en:
The logit lens reads an intermediate state with the model’s own output frame ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ) , and it underlies studies of how predictions are refined across depth ( Jastrzębski et al., 2017 ; Geva et al., 2020 ; Geva et al., 2022 ; Dar et al., 2022 ; Halawi et al., 2023 ; Katz et al., 2024 ; Wendler et al., 2024 ; Lad et al., 2024 ) .
Later lenses use a map per layer, trained to match the output ( Belrose et al., 2023 ; Din et al., 2023 ) or given by a Jacobian of the remaining layers ( Hernandez et al., 2023 ; Gurnee et al., 2026 ) , or patch the state into another forward pass ( Ghandeharioun et al., 2024 ; Pal et al., 2023 ) . Gu et al. (2026c) fix a set of anchors and measure the states of all layers against them, and Gu et al. (2026b) tie the input and output frames to each other through the pseudo-inverse of one shared token memory.
Lenses are thus frames that ignore the context, and we bound how closely any can approximate the native frame.
blocks.zh:
logit镜头读取了一个带有模型自身输出框架的中间状态(怀旧代数,2020年),它基于对如何完善跨深度预测的研究(Jastrzębski等人,2017年;Geva等人,2020年;Geva等人,2022年;Dar等人,2022年;Halawi等人,2023年;Katz等人,2024年;Wendler等人,2024年;Lad等人,2024年)。
后期镜头使用每层地图,经过训练与输出相匹配(Belrose等人,2023年;Din等人,2023年),或由余层的一位雅各宾人给出(Hernandez等人,2023年;Gurnee等人,2026年),或将状态补上另一个前传(Ghandeharioun等人,2024年;Pal等人,2023年). Gu et al. (2026c)固定一组锚,并测量所有层的状态与它们相对应,Gu et al. (2026b)通过一个共享符号内存的伪反向将输入框和输出框绑在一起.
因此,Lenses是忽略上下文的帧,我们决定了任何可以接近原生帧的距离。

blocks.en:
A large body of work summarises the states of a layer by statistics of the cloud they form, such as similarity between layers ( Raghu et al., 2017 ; Kornblith et al., 2019 ) , intrinsic dimension ( Facco et al., 2018 ; Ansuini et al., 2019 ; Valeriani et al., 2023 ) , effective rank ( Garrido et al., 2022 ) and anisotropy ( Ethayarajh, 2019 ; Gao et al., 2019 ; Razzhigaev et al., 2023 ; Bernas et al., 2026 ) .
Recent studies follow these statistics across layers ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Skean et al., 2025 ) and across training ( Saphra and Lopez, 2018 ; Tigges et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2024 ) .
We quantify how much these statistics reveal about the way the model uses the states of a layer.
blocks.zh:
大量的工作通过对云层形成的统计数据来总结层层的状态,如层层之间的相似性(Raghu等人,2017年;Kornblith等人,2019年),内在维度(Facco等人,2018年;Ansuini等人,2019年;Valeriani等人,2023年),有效级(Garrido等人,2022年)和异构(Ethayarajh等人,2019年;Gao等人,2019年;Razzzigaev等人,2023年;Bernas等人,2026年).
最近的研究遵循了这些跨层统计(Cheng等人,2024年;Skean等人,2025年)和跨培训(Saphra和Lopez,2018年;Tigges等人,2024年;Lee等人,2024年)。
我们量化这些统计数据揭示了该模型如何使用一层状态。

blocks.en:
Linear probes learn a direction from labelled states ( Alain and Bengio, 2016 ; Tenney et al., 2019 ; Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ; Belinkov, 2021 ) , and steering methods add a direction to the states to change the output ( Subramani et al., 2022 ; Turner et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2023 ; Panickssery et al., 2023 ; Arditi et al., 2024 ) .
Both rest on the hypothesis that concepts are represented as directions ( Park et al., 2023 ) , which Park et al. (2026) derive from the information geometry of the softmax for the output layer only.
The contribution of a component to a prediction is likewise computed along a direction, by projecting what the component writes onto the output frame ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , or measured by patching ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Conmy et al., 2023 ; Syed et al., 2023 ) .
A frame supplies directions for each state without supervision, and we test them in steering and attribution at every layer.
blocks.zh:
线性探测器从标签状态学习方向(Alain和Bengio,2016年;Tenney等人,2019年;Hewitt和Liang,2019年;Belinkov,2021年),以及引导方法为状态增加了改变输出的方向(Subramani等人,2022年;Turner等人,2023年;Li等人,2023年;Zou等人,2023年;Panickssery等人,2023年;Arditi等人,2024年)。
两者都以概念作为方向的假设(Park et al., 2023 ),Park et al. (2026)来源于仅用于输出层的软马克斯信息几何.
同样,通过对输出框架(Wang等人,2022年)进行投影,或通过补丁(Meng等人,2022年;Conmy等人,2023年;Syed等人,2023年)进行测算,计算某一组成部分对预测的贡献。
一个框架为每个州提供方向,没有监督,我们在每个层次上都用方向和归属来测试它们.

blocks.zh: 3 语法参考框架

A state receives its meaning from the layers that remain, which read it from the stream.
They transport x ℓ ​ ( t ) x_{\ell}(t) , together with the states of its prefix, to the last layer, where the output frame applies.

The lexical basis at the layer is s ℓ ​ ( v ) = J ℓ + ​ s v s_{\ell}(v)=J_{\ell}^{+}s_{v} , the direction in which the state must move for the output to move along s v s_{v} .
Both are determined anew for every state, as Figure 2 illustrates: they depend on the layer, since J ℓ J_{\ell} contains all remaining layers, and on the context, since these layers attend to the prefix.

blocks.en: Figure 3: What a frame of each order computes to read the state at position t t of layer ℓ \ell : the layer’s own attention (solid black) and typical attention outputs (dashed blue). The order in brackets counts the rounds of attention between positions above layer ℓ \ell , like hops of message passing: the context reaches the state only through the state itself (0), directly from the prefix (1), through one relay in the prefix (2), or without limit ( ∞ \infty ).

blocks.en:
A frame of order n n replaces the transport T ℓ T_{\ell} by one that computes only n n rounds of attention between positions, and so has its own lexical readouts, lexical basis and reading q ℓ ( n ) q^{(n)}_{\ell} .
Its transport still runs through every remaining layer, which makes it specific to the layer; from order 1 on the state also attends to its prefix, and the order counts the hops that information may travel between positions above layer ℓ \ell .
A frame that withholds more is further from the model but more informative about the state, and as nothing in it is fitted to the model’s output, agreement with the model is a finding.
As Figure 3 shows, every remaining layer updates the state at position t t from the state one layer below and its attention over the other positions; all frames keep the first input and differ in the second.

LexFrame [0] withholds the prefix and reads a state without its context, and its reading is what the state holds by itself.
It transports x ℓ ​ ( t ) x_{\ell}(t) through the layers k > ℓ k>\ell with the model’s own F k F_{k} , and it replaces the attention output by a typical one, a ^ k ​ ( u ) = a ¯ k + ( u − u ¯ k ) ​ G k , \hat{a}_{k}(u)=\bar{a}_{k}+(u-\bar{u}_{k})\,G_{k}, (3) where u u is the attention input at position t t , u ¯ k \bar{u}_{k} and a ¯ k \bar{a}_{k} are the means of the attention input and output of layer k k , and G k G_{k} is the ridge regression of the attention output on its input, fitted once for each layer on unlabelled calibration text.
Because the transport keeps every remaining layer, LexFrame [0] is still a nonlinear reading that depends on the state, unlike a lens, and it lacks only what the remaining layers would gather from other positions.

blocks.en:
LexFrame [1] lets the state attend to its prefix.
The state at position t t is transported as before, but in every layer its attention is the layer’s own attention, computed over the prefix.
The states of the prefix are themselves transported from layer ℓ \ell by LexFrame [0] , so the frame withholds only the attention among the prefix positions after layer ℓ \ell .
The state attends with the layer’s own queries, keys and values, but each prefix position evolves in isolation.
The reading is what the state draws from its prefix; the step from LexFrame [0] measures what this one round of attention contributes.
blocks.zh:
LexFrame [1] 让州关注其前缀.
Tt位置的状态和以前一样被运走,但在每一层中,它的注意力是该层自己的注意力,从前缀上计算。

读取是状态从它的前缀中提取的;LexFrame[0]中的步骤衡量这轮注意力的贡献.

blocks.en:
In LexFrame [2] the attention also reaches within the prefix: the prefix positions attend too, each with the layer’s own attention over its own prefix, which is transported by LexFrame [0] .
Information can therefore travel two steps, from an earlier token through a prefix position to the state, a route that LexFrame [1] cannot represent.
The step from LexFrame [1] to LexFrame [2] measures what this one exchange among the prefix positions contributes.
In general LexFrame [ n n ] attends to a prefix of states of order n − 1 n-1 ; each order thus computes one more round of attention between positions, and reading at order n n runs n + 1 n+1 streams through the remaining layers.
Higher orders add exchanges within the prefix and converge to the model.
blocks.zh:
在LexFrame语中 [2] 注意也到达前缀内:前缀位置也出席,每个前缀上都有层自己注意的,由LexFrame[0]运输.

从LexFrame[1]到LexFrame[2]的一步衡量了前缀位置之间这一次交换的贡献.
一般来说,LexFrame [nn] 注意一个序号n−1n-1的状态前缀;每个序号由此计算出位置之间再加一回合的注意力,按序号n的读取会通过剩余层运行n+1n+1的流.
更高的订单会增加前缀内的交换,并汇合到模型中.

blocks.en:
In the limit of the order nothing is withheld, and LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] recovers the model as the native frame: every position attends to the true states of its prefix, which are the states that the model itself computes.
Two identities follow: the reading of every layer in LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] equals the model’s output, and LexFrame [ n n ] is exact wherever at most n n layers remain.
Near the output all orders therefore agree with the model; they differ where much of the computation lies ahead.
The reading of LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] adds nothing to the model’s prediction; its value lies in its lexical readouts and basis, which every frame of finite order approximates.

以下两个身份: LexFrame [QQ\\fty] 中每个层的读取值等于模型的输出值, LexFrame [nn] 在最多为n 层的剩余位置是准确的 。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments

blocks.en:
We compare frames with lenses and point clouds, then test their coordinates and their use in steering and attribution.
Appendix A details the setup; Appendix B adds training checkpoints, lexical readouts, context length, settling depth and ablations.

附 录 附录B增加了培训检查站、词汇读取、上下文长度、定居深度和拼贴。

blocks.en:
We use SmolLM3-3B with 36 layers and OLMo3-7B with 32 layers, recent competitive open-weight models that release checkpoints from every stage of training; SmolLM3 ties its input and output embeddings, OLMo3 does not.
We run them in the precision of the released weights and report pairs of values in this order.
Text comes from WikiText-103, cut into sequences of 128 tokens.
The typical attention outputs are estimated on 256 sequences of the training split, and every measurement uses the test split and every layer.
The Jacobian lens is fitted with its reference implementation on 100 prompts.
We omit the tuned lens, which is trained on the model’s output, the quantity on which readings are scored, and is bounded like every lens.
As a supervised reference we add a linear probe, a ridge regression of the centred logit on the states, fitted on separate text.
Divergences are Kullback–Leibler divergences from the model’s output to a reading, in nats, and averages over layers are unweighted. LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] is the reference for readings and the exact frame in interventions.

我们省略了调制镜头,它训练了模型的输出,读数的分数,并且像每个镜头一样被限定。

blocks.en:
The divergence from the model’s output (Figure 4 ) shows the same ladder: averaged over layers, LexFrame [0] is at 0.87 and 0.93 nats, LexFrame [1] at 0.16 and 0.15, and LexFrame [2] at 0.06 and 0.05.
The first round of attention thus closes most of the divergence of LexFrame [0] : at mid-depth LexFrame [1] is within 0.04 and 0.05 nats, and from there on a state and one round of attention to its prefix determine nearly all of its reading.
The lenses diverge by several nats, although LexFrame [0] uses no more of the context than they do; transport through the model’s own layers hence matters more than a fitted map.
The gap is widest in SmolLM3, whose output frame is also its input frame: at the embedding its logit lens names the input token itself for 0.83 of the positions, against 0.00 in OLMo3.
Conversely, a layer skip, which feeds a layer’s states to the last four layers with attention but without transport, remains at 7.00 and 2.59 nats: a reading needs both transport and attention.
blocks.zh:
与模型输出的区别(图4)显示相同的阶梯:平均在层上,LexFrame[0]为0.87和0.93纳特,LexFrame[1]为0.16和0.15,LexFrame[2]为0.06和0.05.
第一轮的注意力因此关闭了LexFrame[0]的大部分分歧:在中深度的LexFrame[1]在0.04和0.05纳特以内,从那里开始,一回合的注意力到它的前缀,几乎决定了它的读数.
虽然LexFrame [0] 使用的上下文并不比它们多;因此,通过模型本身的层进行运输比安装的地图更重要。
SmolLM3中差距最大,其输出框架也是其输入框架:在嵌入其logit镜头时,将0.83个位置的输入符本身命名,而OLMo3中的输入符为0.
反之,将一层的状态反馈到最后四层,但注意而无运输能力,这一层的跳动仍然是7.00和2.59纳特:读数既需要运输,也需要注意。

blocks.en:
In Table 1 , LexFrame [1] names the model’s top token for 0.86 and 0.86 of the states, and for nine tenths of them from layer 18 and 17 on, whereas the lenses reach one half only one or two layers before the output. LexFrame [1] does not merely reproduce the output: at the embedding, where most of the computation remains, it agrees on only 0.42 and 0.39.
Its calibration error against the actual next token, 0.027 and 0.018, is close to that of the model itself, 0.018 and 0.023, so its probabilities can be interpreted as a prediction in their own right, unlike those of the lenses.
Counted back from the last layer, LexFrame [1] keeps the model’s top token over 0.82 and 0.81 of the layers, a lens over at most 0.11.
An early exit at the first layer whose reading is confident, with the threshold set on held-out sequences for 0.95 agreement with the model, would therefore skip 0.45 and 0.42 of the layers with LexFrame [1] but at most 0.04 with a lens, whose confidence does not track whether it is right.
Along training, a fixed lens loses ground: from the first trained to the last checkpoint, the divergence of the logit lens grows from 4.82 to 29.06 nats in SmolLM3 and from 2.32 to 5.66 in OLMo3, while LexFrame [1] keeps the model’s top token on at least 0.85 and 0.86 of the states throughout.
blocks.zh:
在表1中,LexFrame [1] 将模型的顶号标注在0.86和0.86的状态上,从第18层和第17层标注在其中的十分之九,而镜头在输出前只达到一半的一层或两层. LexFrame [1] 不仅仅复制输出:在嵌入时,大部分计算仍然保留,它只同意0.42和0.39.
其校准误差与实际的下一个代号,0.027和0.018相近,接近于模型本身,0.018和0.023,因此其概率可以被解释为自身的一种预测,与镜头的概率不同.
从最后一层算回来的 LexFrame [1] 使模型的顶级标志超过0.82和0.81层,一个镜头最多超过0.11层.
第一层的早期退出,其读取充满信心,其阈值设定在与模型的0.95协议的搁置序列上,因此会跳过与LexFrame的0.45和0.42层[1],但最多是0.04镜头,其信心无法跟踪是否正确.
在训练的同时,一个固定镜头会失去地面:从第一个训练到最后一个检查点,日志镜头的分数从SmolLM3的4.82到29.06纳特,从2.32到OLMo3的5.66,而LexFrame[1]则将模型的顶号保留在全州的至少0.85和0.86上.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Point-Cloud Geometry
blocks.zh: 4.2 与点-云几何的比较

blocks.en: Without a frame, a point cloud relates to the model’s computation only through distances.
blocks.zh: 没有框架,一个点云只通过距离与模型的计算有关。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Share of a lexical readout’s squared norm in 64 local or global principal directions of the cloud.
blocks.zh: 图5 云的64个地方或全球主要方向的词汇读取方程规范份额。

blocks.en:
We replace the state of one position by the real state of another position at the same layer, complete the forward pass, and measure the change in the output, for 7961 pairs per layer.
Table 2 shows that, averaged over layers, no distance on the cloud predicts this change well: none exceeds a rank correlation of 0.28, and the geodesic distance, which follows the curvature of the cloud, performs worse than the plain cosine distance.
The divergence between the readings of the two states in LexFrame [1] reaches 0.94 and 0.95, and already 0.64 and 0.66 at the embedding, because it compares them in exactly the directions to which the remaining layers respond.
Along fixed directions, a lens reaches at most 0.28, so a reading must also follow the frame.
blocks.zh:
我们用同一层另一个位置的真实状态来取代一个位置的状态,完成前传,测量输出的变化,每层7961对.
表2显示,经层层平均计算,云层上没有距离能很好地预测这一变化:无一超过0.28的阶次相关性,按照云层曲率排列的大地测量距离表现比平原的余弦距离差.
在LexFrame[1]中两个州的读数差距达到0.94和0.95,在嵌入时已经达到0.64和0.66,因为它将这两个州的读数进行精确的比对,其余各层响应的方向.
沿着固定方向,一个镜头达到最多0.28,所以读数也必须跟随帧.

blocks.en: Table 2: Rank correlation between a distance of two states and the effect of replacing one by the other.
blocks.zh: 表2:两个州的距离与以另一个州取代一个州的影响之间的排名关联。

blocks.en:
Figure 5 explains this in terms of the framework: for each state we estimate the tangent space of the cloud from its 128 nearest states and measure how much of a lexical readout falls into its 64 leading directions.
The local share peaks at 9.2 and 2.9 percent, at most about three times the 3.1 and 1.6 percent of a random direction.
Since a lexical readout is the gradient of a logit, moving along the directions in which the cloud varies changes the logits far less than moving as far along the readout: the cloud mainly describes variation that the remaining layers ignore, yet distances weigh it fully.
blocks.zh:
图5用框架来解释这一点:对于每个州,我们估计其128个最近的州云的切合空间,并衡量一个词汇读数有多少属于64个主要方向。
当地份额最高达到9.2%和2.9%,最多是随机方向的3.1和1.6%的三倍。
由于一个词典读取是一个对数的梯度,沿云变化的方向移动会使对数远小于沿读取方向移动: 云主要描述的是剩余层忽略的变数,然而距离完全重.

blocks.en: 4.3 Coordinates at Intermediate Layers
blocks.zh: 4.3 中层坐标

blocks.en:
At the output, the vocabulary is a coordinate system for the residual stream: the lexical basis gives the axes, the directions in which writing a label moves a state, and the coefficients give the coordinates, how much of each label the state holds.
Together they compose a state from labels; we test whether a frame carries both to intermediate layers.
blocks.zh:
在输出时,词汇是剩余流的坐标系统:词典基础给出轴,写一个标签移动一个状态的方向,系数给出坐标,该状态持有的每个标签的多少.
它们共同从标签中组成一个状态; 我们测试一个框架是否同时包含到中间层。

blocks.en:
We compute J ℓ J_{\ell} in 32-bit precision for 64 states per layer, move each state by 0.1 of its norm along s ℓ ​ ( v ) s_{\ell}(v) for 64 labels, and ask whether v v is the label whose logit gains most, which Table 3 counts.
For the lexical basis at the layer this holds in 0.98 and 1.00 of the cases, from the first layers on.
The lexical readout of LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] succeeds less often, in 0.56 and 0.79: as the gradient J ℓ ⊤ ​ ( w v − w ¯ ) J_{\ell}^{\top}(w_{v}-\bar{w}) of the logit of v v , it raises v v fastest but also every label whose logit moves with it, and it agrees with J ℓ + ​ s v J_{\ell}^{+}s_{v} only where the remaining layers stretch all directions alike.
The direction that measures a label is therefore not the direction that moves the output toward it.
The fixed frames do worse than the basis: the output frame, with s v s_{v} unchanged, reaches 0.45 and 0.80, and the input frame reaches 0.42 in SmolLM3, which ties its input and output embeddings, and 0.00 in OLMo3, which does not.
With the Jacobian of LexFrame [1] , the share is 0.84 and 0.97, against 0.54 and 0.73 for its readout, so the frame supplies most of the basis itself.
blocks.zh:
我们以每层64个状态的32位精度计算J l J_{\ell}, 将每个状态按照规范的0.1 沿着 s l (v) s_{\ell} (v) 沿着 64 个标签移动, 并询问 v 是否是其登录得分最高的标签, 表 3 计数 。
就地层的词汇基础而言,从第一层起,这在0.98和1.00个案例中占有重要地位。
LexFrame的词典读出[\\\fty]成功次数较少,在0.56和0.79中:由于V的日志中的梯度J l {(w v − ̄)}(w_{v} -\bar{w}),它提高了v v,但也增加了每个与之相通的标签,它同意J l + s v J_{\ell}^{+}s_{v},只有剩下的各层都横跨所有方向。
因此,衡量标签的方向不是将产出朝向它的方向。
固定帧比基数更差:输出帧,S v s_{v}不变,达到0.45和0.80,输入帧在SmolLM3中达到0.42,将输入和输出嵌入连接起来,在OLMo3中达到0.00,没有.
与LexFrame的Jacobian [1],其份额为0.84和0.97,而其读取量为0.54和0.73,因此帧本身供给了大部分的基础.

blocks.en: Table 3: Share of moves along the lexical readout or basis of a label that raise its logit most, averaged over layers; fixed frames use their basis unchanged.
blocks.zh: 表 3: 沿词典读出或标签基础的移动份额,这些移动最多,平均分层;固定框使用其基础不变。

blocks.en:
Table 4 tests whether the coefficient of a label, its inner product with the unembedding row after it, can do without the transport.
With the state of the layer itself, or with its image under one fixed map per layer, it is several nats from the model’s logits, and with the state that LexFrame [1] transports it is within 0.16 and 0.15 nats.
Nor can the transport be linearised: the inner product of the lexical readout of LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] with the state of its layer has a correlation of only 0.10 and 0.02 with the logit, because the readout is the slope of the logit at the state and not a measure of how much of the label the state holds.
An adaptive frame is local: basis and coefficients hold at one state and are tied by the transport, not by one matrix as at the output.
blocks.zh:
表4测试一个标签的系数,其内产物与它之后的未嵌入的行,是否可以不进行迁移.
以地层本身的状态,或以每层一个固定地图下的图象,它是模型的对数中的数个纳特,与LexFrame[1]在0.16和0.15纳特范围内运输.
迁移也不能线性化:LexFrame[Q∞\fty]的词典读出的内部产物与其层的状态只有0.10和0.02与logit的关联,因为读出是logit在状态的坡度,而不是该状态所持有的标签多少的度量.
适应性框架是局部的:基数和系数维持在一个状态上,与运输相连,而不是与产出一样由一个矩阵相连。

blocks.en: Table 4: Coefficients on the output lexical basis against model logits on 512 positions, averaged over layers: divergence (nats) at the best scale, top-token agreement.
blocks.zh: 表4:与512个位置的模型对数相比,在输出法基础上的系数,平均分层:最大尺度的差(nats),顶级协议。

blocks.en: 4.4 Steering and Attribution
blocks.zh: 4.4 指导和分配

blocks.en:
The two halves of these coordinates serve two interventions on the stream: steering writes into it along the basis, and attribution reads through the coefficients what a component wrote.
In steering, the task is to make the runner-up token u u , the target that needs the smallest move, overtake the top token v v by moving a single state.
A frame offers two directions for this: the lexical readout of the logit difference, b ℓ ​ ( u ) − b ℓ ​ ( v ) b_{\ell}(u)-b_{\ell}(v) , which is its gradient, and the difference of the lexical basis vectors, s ℓ ​ ( u ) − s ℓ ​ ( v ) s_{\ell}(u)-s_{\ell}(v) .
We move each state along each direction in steps from 0.01 to 1 times its norm and record the first step that flips the prediction and the change in the other tokens at that step.
blocks.zh:
这些坐标的两半为溪流上的两种干预措施服务:方向沿基础写进,归属通过系数读取一个组件所写的.
在引导中,任务在于让跑步的sorder u u,即需要最小动作的目标,通过移动单个状态来超越顶级sorder v.
框架为此提供了两个方向:逻辑差异的词典读出,b l (u) − b l (v) b → ell } (u) - b → ell } (v),即它的梯度,和词典基础矢量的差,s l (u) − s l (v) s → ell } (u) - s_{\ell } (v).
我们把每一个国家沿着每个方向移动,从0.01到1倍于它的规范,并记录第一个步骤,该步骤推翻了预测,并改变了其他迹象。

blocks.en: Table 5: Steering along the lexical readout or basis, averaged over layers: share of predictions flipped, median change in the other tokens at the first flip (nats), and share flipped with a change below 0.1 nats.
blocks.zh: 表5:沿词典读出或基数方向,层数平均:预测翻转的比例,第一个翻转时其他符号(nats)的中位变化,和0.1 nats以下变化的翻转共享.

blocks.en:
Along the lexical readout, LexFrame [1] flips 0.92 and 0.94 of the predictions, nearly as many as LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] with 0.95 and 0.97, and the lenses at most 0.81.
The lexical basis flips nearly as many, but it disturbs the other tokens far less, 0.009 and 0.004 nats at the flip against 0.033 and 0.025, and therefore makes the most clean flips, 0.73 and 0.85 of the predictions.
As in the lexical-basis test, the readout is the steepest ascent of the logit difference and spreads the change over every token moving with u u or v v , while the basis is the move whose first-order effect on the output comes closest to raising u u against v v alone.
The basis computed from the Jacobian of LexFrame [1] reaches 0.71 and 0.82; selective steering thus works even without access to the Jacobian of the model itself.
At single positions of layer 16, the readout of LexFrame [1] flips the prediction with a median step of 0.10 and 0.03 of the state’s norm, as for LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] , while both lenses need steps ten times as large.
blocks.zh:
沿词典读出,LexFrame[1]翻转了预测的0.92和0.94,几乎与LexFrame[ \\fty]一样多,有0.95和0.97,镜头最多0.81.
字法基础翻转几乎一样多,但比翻转时的0.009和0.004纳特远为扰动其他信使,因此使得预测中最干净的翻转,0.73和0.85.
如Lexical-Basis测试中,读出是日志差异中最陡峭的上升点,并将变化分布在随u u 或 v v 移动的每个符号上,而基调则是其输出的第一阶效应最接近于单独抚养u u v.
从LexFrame的Jacobian人[1]计算出来的基数达到0.71和0.82;因此,即使无法接触到模型本身的Jacobian人,选择性的引导也是有效的.
在第16层的单位上,LexFrame的读出[1]以该州规范的0.10和0.03的中位阶翻转预测,至于LexFrame[ \\fty],而两个镜头都需要十倍大的步数.

blocks.en:
In attribution, the task is to quantify how much a component, a layer or one of its two sublayers, contributed to the centred logit of the predicted token.
As the reference we remove what the component wrote at one position, leave the prefix untouched, complete the forward pass, and measure the change in the logit, on 64 sequences.
This effect is the difference of coefficients in LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] , so the test asks whether a frame that withholds exchanges within the prefix still attributes as the model does.
In a frame, the attribution is the change in the coefficient of the predicted token when the component is removed from the state.
We compare it with the same difference taken in the two lenses, of which the logit lens gives direct logit attribution, and with linear attributions, the inner product of a lexical readout with the component, which for LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] is attribution patching ( Syed et al., 2023 ; Kramár et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
在归属方面,任务是量化一个组件,一个层或其两个子层中的一个,对预测的符号的中心对数贡献了多少.
作为参考,我们删除组件在一个位置上所写的内容,留下前缀不动,完成前传,并在64个序列上测量日志的变化.
这种效应是LexFrame [QQ\\fty] 中系数的差别,因此测试中询问,一个在前缀内扣动交换的帧是否仍然像模型那样属性.
在一个框架中,归属是指组件脱离状态时预测符的系数变化.
我们把它和两个镜头中相同的区别比较,其中logit镜头给出了直接的logit归属,而线性属性,一个词典读出与组件的内在产物,对于LexFrame[ \\\\fty]来说是归属补丁(Syed等人,2023年;Kramár等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Table 6: Layer-averaged correlation of attributed and measured effects on the predicted logit.
blocks.zh: 表6:可归属和计量效应对预测对数的层平均相关性。

blocks.en:
In Table 6 , the difference in LexFrame [1] follows the measured effect at 0.88 and 0.90, closer than the linear attribution of LexFrame [ ∞ \infty ] , at 0.62 and 0.68, although the latter uses the model’s Jacobian.
The agreement holds at single positions: across their layers, the difference correlates with the measured effect at 0.97 and 0.93 in the median and exceeds both lenses at 0.99 and 0.98 of positions.
A linear attribution assumes that the effect of a write is proportional to it, and its deficit is largest for the feed-forward block (MLP), 0.88 and 0.90 against 0.63 and 0.71, but small for attention, 0.79 and 0.85 against 0.75 and 0.84: the remaining layers respond almost linearly to attention writes and far beyond first order to feed-forward writes.
The two lenses reach at most 0.20: direct logit attribution measures only the direct path from a write to the output, which carries little of the effect.
blocks.zh:
在表6中,LexFrame[1]的区别跟随了0.88和0.90的测量效应,比LexFrame[Q∞\fty]的线性归属更接近,0.62和0.68,尽管后者使用模型的雅各比亚.
协议维持在单一位置:在层层之间,差异与中位数0.97和0.93的测量效果相关,在0.99和0.98的位置上均超过两个透镜。
线性归属假设一个书写的效果与其成正比,其赤字对饲料前进块(MLP)最大,0.88和0.90对0.63和0.71对,但对于注意则较小,0.79和0.85对0.75和0.84:其余的层几乎是线性响应注意写作,远远超出了第一顺序的饲料前进写作.
两个镜头最多达到0.20:直接对数归属度量只有从写到输出的直接路径,其效果很少.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Every hidden state of a language model has a native reference frame, fixed at the two ends of the residual stream and adaptive in between, and lexical reference frames approximate it to a stated order without fitting to the model’s output.
In two model families LexFrame [1] recovers the model’s lexical readouts and output from mid-depth on, beyond the reach of any method with one map per layer, and it attributes and steers predictions.
The frame explains why a fixed lens fails at mid-depth, increasingly so along training, and why the point cloud reveals little about how the model uses a state.
To interpret a state, read it as the model does: through the layers that remain, with the context it sees, and in its own native semantics, a reading that can stand in for lenses.
blocks.zh:
语言模型的每一个隐藏状态都有一个原生参考框架,固定在残流的两端,并在两者之间适应,而词汇参考框架则将其近似于一个未与模型输出相适应的既定顺序。
在两个模型家族中 LexFrame [1] 从中深度恢复模型的词典读取和输出,超出每层一个地图的任何方法所能达到的范围,它属性和引导预测.
框架解释了为什么一个固定镜头在中深处失败,在训练过程中越来越失败,为什么点云很少揭示模型如何使用状态.
为了诠释一个状态,读作模型所做的:通过留下的层,用它所看到的上下文,在它自己的本土语义中,一个可以代表镜头的读物.

blocks.en: Appendix A Technical Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 技术细节

blocks.en: A.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: A.1 执行细节

blocks.en:
The SmolLM3 checkpoints follow a grid in which the number of training tokens roughly triples from one checkpoint to the next, and the OLMo3 checkpoints are chosen at matching token counts, with the randomly initialised model and an early checkpoint at four billion tokens in addition.
Both families include the checkpoints at the end of their later training stages.
The Jacobian lens is defined from layer 1 on, and every average over layers runs over layers 1 to L − 1 L-1 , without the embedding, where the Jacobian lens is undefined, and the output, where every reading is exact.
We calibrate on 256 sequences of 128 tokens from the training split and evaluate on 64 sequences of 128 tokens from the test split.
blocks.zh:
SmolLM3检查站采用一个网格,其中训练信使的数量从一个检查站到另一个检查站大约为三倍,OLMo3检查站的选择与信使计数相匹配,随机公布模式和提前设立40亿信使的检查站。
两个家庭在后来的培训阶段结束时都设有检查站。
雅各宾镜头从第1层起定义,每层以上的平均值都贯穿第1层至L−1L-1,没有嵌入,其中雅各宾镜头未定义,输出,每读数准确.
我们校准256个序列 128个符号 从训练分裂, 并评估64个序列 128个符号 从测试分裂。

blocks.en:

Across checkpoints, the ranking of the readings is stable in both families.
In SmolLM3 the divergence of the logit lens from the model’s output grows from 4.82 to 29.06 nats, while that of LexFrame [1] only moves from 0.15 to 0.16.
The decline of the logit lens thus follows the rotation of the frame at mid-depth: a lens degrades not because the model becomes harder to read but because the model’s own frames move away from the output frame.
Averaged over layers, LexFrame [1] agrees with the model’s top token on at least 0.85 and 0.86 of the states at every trained checkpoint, while the logit lens falls from 0.21 to 0.04 and from 0.27 to 0.15.
Every value is an average over all layers and over the same 64 test sequences, and the typical attention outputs are estimated anew at every checkpoint, so the comparison along training is free of the confound that a lens fitted at one checkpoint is stale at the next.
The randomly initialised OLMo3 is a control: LexFrame [1] is within 0.11 nats of its output and the logit lens 0.52 nats away, as every frame is built from its model’s layers.

The divergence of LexFrame [1] from the model’s output rises only from 0.16 and 0.15 to 0.25 and 0.18 nats; the order of all methods is unchanged, with LexFrame [0] at 1.11 and 1.06, LexFrame [2] at 0.15 and 0.08 and the lenses at 6.04 or more, and LexFrame [1] still agrees with the model’s top token on 0.84 and 0.86 of the states.

Table 9 shows a position where OLMo3 continues “A review of Boulter ’s performance in The” with “ Guardian ” at probability 0.29 rather than “ Times ” at 0.22. LexFrame [1] names this token from layer 16 on, the Jacobian lens from layer 20 on and the logit lens from layer 24 on, so the frame reads the prediction well before either lens.
Below that layer LexFrame [1] already reads whole words that can follow “The” here, and at layer 12 the runner-up “ Times ”: the state hence holds the two newspaper titles that the model weighs at the output, and the next layers settle between them.
The logit lens returns mostly word fragments until layer 24, because it reads every state along the output directions, which intermediate states do not yet use.
The Jacobian lens returns unrelated tokens until layer 20, since its map averages over contexts and cannot follow this one, although it is fitted to the model’s own Jacobian.
The position thus shows in a single case what the statistics over all positions report in aggregate: the frame follows the model’s own choice, including the alternative it weighs, several layers before either of the two lenses does.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: C.3 Complexity Analysis

blocks.en:
We count costs in forward passes, a measure independent of the hardware.
Calibration is one forward pass over the calibration text and one ridge regression per layer.
Reading the states of layer ℓ \ell at order n n runs n + 1 n+1 streams through the L − ℓ L-\ell remaining layers, so reading every layer of a sequence, at all positions at once, costs about ( n + 1 ) ​ ( L + 1 ) / 2 (n+1)(L+1)/2 forward passes.
A fitted lens reads a state with one matrix product, which is cheaper per state, but the fit is not: the Jacobian lens needs the Jacobian of the last state with respect to the states of every layer, one backward pass per dimension of the state, for each of its P P prompts, about P ​ d Pd backward passes in total.
With LexFrame [1] , a lens therefore becomes cheaper only after about P ​ d / ( L + 1 ) Pd/(L+1) sequences have been read at every layer, and the fit must be repeated for every checkpoint, while a frame only repeats its calibration pass.
Fitting the Jacobian lens took 18 and 44 times as long as calibrating the frames and reading every layer of the 64 test sequences at orders 0 to 2.

blocks.en: Appendix D Discussion
blocks.zh: 附录D 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The framework rests on one idea: read a hidden state as the model reads it, through the layers that remain and with the context it sees.
Lenses read each layer with one fixed map, and point clouds read no state at all; a frame lets the remaining layers, which decide what a state means, do the reading in the model’s native semantics, its vocabulary.
blocks.zh:
框架基于一种想法:读取一个隐藏状态,如模型读取时,通过遗留的层层和它所看到的上下文.
Lenses用一个固定的地图来读每个图层,点云完全读不出状态;一个框架让剩下的图层,决定状态的含义,在模型的本土语义,其词汇中进行读取.

blocks.en:
A reference frame separates two questions that a lens answers at once: along which directions the model measures a label at a state, and how much of the label the state holds.
Existing methods appear as special cases: a lens is a frame that does not adapt to the context and is therefore bounded by the coherence of the native frame, a probe is a fixed lexical readout learned under supervision, and a point cloud is a set of states without a frame.
The native frame answers both questions exactly, and the orders make it informative by stating what is withheld.
Both parts of the model’s reading are necessary: transport alone, in LexFrame [0] , already brings a reading far closer to the model than any fitted map, whereas attention to the prefix without transport, in a layer skip, does not, and no fitting lifts a method that ignores the context above the coherence bound.
The order thus makes the use of the context a controlled variable, so that what each hop between positions contributes can be measured.
blocks.zh:
一个参考框架将一个镜头同时回答的两个问题分开:一个模型沿着哪个方向测量一个状态的标签,以及该状态所持有的标签的多少.
现有方法作为特例出现:一个镜头是无法适应上下文的帧,因此以原生帧的一致性为界,一个探针是在监督下学到的固定的词典读出,一个点云是一组没有帧的状态.
原生框架准确回答了两个问题,而命令则通过说明被扣留的内容而使其信息丰富.
模型的两部分读数都是必要的:单是运输,在LexFrame [0]中,已经比任何安装的地图更接近模型的读数,而注意没有运输的前缀,在图层跳过时,是不会的,任何合适的提法都会忽略一致性约束上方的上下文.
因此,顺序使上下文的使用成为可控变量,从而可以衡量位置之间每个跳动的贡献.

blocks.en:
The value of this view lies in what it makes comparable.
The vocabulary is shared by every layer, checkpoint and model of a family, and a frame expresses all of their states in it without a trained component whose faithfulness would need a separate argument.
The native frame is thus a reference against which any interpretation of a hidden state can be scored, and a frame calibrated anew in a single pass can follow a model through training, fine-tuning or editing in the same units.
Early exit, hallucination detection and knowledge editing read hidden states through lenses or probes, and model compression matches the hidden states of a teacher, so each could read these states in the frame of the model instead; we expect such uses to benefit, but leave them to future work.
blocks.zh:
这种观点的价值在于它能产生可比性。
家庭的每个层次、检查站和模式都使用这些词汇,一个框架表达家庭内部的所有状态,没有经过训练的成分,其忠诚需要单独论证。
因此,本体帧是一种参考,任何对隐藏状态的解释都可以以此为参照,单传中重新校准的帧可以通过训练,微调或编辑相同单位的模型.
早期退出,幻觉检测和知识编辑通过镜头或探针读取隐藏状态,模型压缩与教师的隐藏状态相匹配,因此每个人都可以在模型的框架里读取这些状态;我们期望这些用途会有所裨益,但把它们留给未来工作.
